title: The Inverted Tower
text: A tower hangs point-down from nothing, its spire aimed at the ground below like a spear. Its windows glow. Its door is at the bottom, which is the top, and it stands open. Somewhere inside, someone is singing upside down.

options.label: Climb up into the hanging tower, and see who sings inside.

outcomes.text: A library upside down, its books still readable if you hang by your knees.
It falls up with you inside, and keeps falling, and you are not sure it ever stops.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks in from below, before anyone climbs.

outcomes.text: Someone upside down looks back, and points the way, and waves.

options.label: Do not go up. A tower that hangs from nothing is not to be trusted.

outcomes.text: The tower turns, slowly, to watch you go.
